rungs.title: Graduate Engineer
rungs.summary: Learning how software gets built and shipped here.
rungs.knowledge: Knows the fundamentals and the team's tools; learns the rest on the job.
rungs.delivery: Completes small, scoped pieces of work with close review.
rungs.leadership: Asks questions early and reports progress without being asked.

rungs.title: Engineer
rungs.summary: Builds and ships features across the stack on their own.
rungs.knowledge: Solid across front end, back end, testing and security basics.
rungs.delivery: Builds, tests and ships a feature end to end with light review.
rungs.leadership: Communicates status clearly and helps newer engineers.

rungs.title: Senior Engineer
rungs.summary: Owns a component and the quality of what the team ships.
rungs.knowledge: Deep in one area, with working knowledge of data, DevOps and architecture.
rungs.delivery: Owns a component from design to production and its reliability.
rungs.leadership: Reviews and mentors; leads a project and builds relationships across teams.

rungs.title: Staff Engineer
rungs.summary: Solves the hardest cross-team problems and sets engineering standards.
rungs.knowledge: Sees the system as a whole, including infrastructure and the cost of delivery.
rungs.delivery: Leads the hardest technical projects across teams.
rungs.leadership: Prefers to manage projects over managing people; shapes standards and grows senior engineers.

rungs.title: Principal Engineer
rungs.summary: An indispensable individual contributor whose judgement the company relies on.
rungs.knowledge: Recognised company-wide expert who anticipates what the next two years will need.
rungs.delivery: Sets the technical direction for major bets and makes them land.
rungs.leadership: Advises executives and is the person other leaders ask first.
